description: This file contains C source code implementing NMEA GPS data parsing functions, including functions to parse specific NMEA sentences (GPGGA and GPRMC), convert coordinate formats, and validate checksums. It also includes utility functions to handle hex and string conversions, and to compute GPS location data from raw NMEA strings.

methods.name: long hex2int(char * a,int len)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string segment to an integer.

methods.name: int str2int(char * a,int len)
methods.description: Converts a string of digits to an integer.

methods.name: float gps_deg_dec(float deg_point)
methods.description: Converts degrees in decimal minutes to decimal degrees format.

methods.name: void gps_convert_deg_to_dec(float * latitude,char ns,float * longitude,char we)
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude from degrees-minutes format to decimal degrees, considering hemispherical indicators.

methods.name: int str_till_comma(char * a,char * dStr)
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a comma-separated string until the comma or maximum length.

methods.name: void nmea_parse_gpgga(char * nmea,loc_t * loc)
methods.description: Parses a GPGGA NMEA sentence to fill location data including coordinates and quality.

methods.name: void nmea_parse_gprmc(char * nmea,loc_t * loc)
methods.description: Parses a GPRMC NMEA sentence to fill location data including coordinates, speed, course, and timestamp.

methods.name: nmea_message_type nmea_get_message_type(const char * message)
methods.description: Identifies the message type of a given NMEA sentence based on its content.

methods.name: int nmea_valid_checksum(const char * message)
methods.description: Validates the checksum of an NMEA message.

methods.name: void gps_location(loc_t * coord,char * buffer)
methods.description: Main function to interpret an NMEA string and populate a location structure with parsed data.
